bretVogelTargetDecks.title: Bret Vogel's 15 Hunting Target Decks

legendaryHunter.title: 8 Legendary Hunter Challenge Animals
legendaryHunter.note: Rockstar keeps the 8 unique target identities concealed in the launch Progress log; track and annotate each unique hunt below.

items.name: Alligator
items.habitat: Grassrivers swamps, murky waterways, and muddy banks
items.notes: Common in Grassrivers swamps, waterways, and muddy banks. Lethal ambush bite in shallow water; use Focus mode (L3 + R3) for clean skull/vital shots.

items.name: Florida Panther / Cougar
items.habitat: Dense pine trails and ridges in Mount Kalaga National Park
items.notes: Stalks dense pine trails and ridges in Mount Kalaga National Park, especially at dusk and night. Tracked during Jason's hunting contracts.

items.name: Black Bear
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga forests, pine valleys, and riverbanks
items.notes: Roams Mount Kalaga forests and riverbanks; charges if provoked or cornered. Bring the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle for Pristine vital kills.

items.name: Bobcat
items.habitat: Rocky brush across Mount Kalaga and rural Ambrosia
items.notes: Agile wildcat spotted in rocky brush across Mount Kalaga and rural Ambrosia.

items.name: Whitetail Buck
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga meadows and Lummox County timberline
items.notes: Antlered male deer grazing in Mount Kalaga meadows; flees quickly when spooked. Core big-game target for Pristine venison & pelt contracts.

items.name: Whitetail Doe
items.habitat: Northern Leonida meadows and forest clearings
items.notes: Found in small herds alongside Whitetail Bucks in northern Leonida.

items.name: Wild Boar
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga National Park & Leonida Keys brush
items.notes: Spotted across Mount Kalaga National Park & Leonida Keys brush; can charge on foot. Featured in early Bret Vogel hunting mechanics.

items.notes: Forages along dirt roadsides and rural scrub in Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia.

items.notes: Invasive primate troops living in Leonida's wooded wetlands and river islands.
